This is likely the same issue as #115017, fixed in godot-cpp by https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/pull/1904 (and just backported to `4.5` with https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/pull/1928). Note that godot-cpp now has a new v10 version on `master` which is no longer tied to a specific Godot branch. So you can use it to get the latest fixes, and compile with `scons api_version=4.5` to support 4.5+.

*Edit:* Also crashing with godot-cpp `master`.

Given the stacktrace, I suggest you should debug further why the extension triggers this crash, as it's related to calling the `mix` method while generating a preview. The fact that Godot crashes is probably still a bug we should look into upstream, but it's likely caused by something the extension does incorrectly.

Yeah, same backtrace with the `master` branch using `api_version=4.5` or `api_version=4.6`; I can't tell if this is something in the extension that needs to be udpated/fixed (*probably*; the original extension was for 4.1.1) or something in the GDExtension interface.
